name: LANDR
tagline: AI mastering, distribution, samples, and plugins for independent musicians.
description: A cloud platform for musicians built around the original AI mastering engine, launched in 2014. Upload a track and get a streaming-ready master in minutes, then distribute to Spotify, Apple Music, and other stores from the same account. The subscription also covers a million-plus sample library and plugin deals; a free account includes a limited number of masters per month.
insight: Born in Montreal as MixGenius; early backers include Nas and Richie Hawtin, and it acquired DAW maker Reason Studios in January 2026.

modelSupport.notes: Proprietary AI mastering engine; processing runs in LANDR's cloud.

edge: The longest-running AI mastering engine, bundled with distribution to streaming services, samples, and plugins in one subscription.
pros: Free tier to try it out
cons: Less control than a human engineer
Weaker on acoustic and jazz mixes

references.title: LANDR Review: Is AI Mastering Worth It in 2026?
